title: Germany in the Early Middle Ages c. 800–1056
usage: Ottonian kingship; imperial coronation of Otto I in Rome in 962; composite structure of the Empire; critique of retrospective national framing.
notes: Standard synthesis; first published by Longman in 1991; DOI is the Routledge reissue. Does not by itself document the later title 'Sacrum Romanum Imperium'.

title: The German Reformation
usage: Reformation as a social and religious process; Luther; popular religion; the Peasants' War and its repression.
notes: Synthesis in the Studies in European History series; DOI is the Palgrave Macmillan e-book.

title: The Thirty Years War: Europe's Tragedy
usage: Outbreak and course of the Thirty Years War; confessional and dynastic conflict; fiscal-military mobilisation; demographic devastation; Peace of Westphalia.
notes: Major scholarly synthesis; DOI is the Harvard University Press e-book.

title: History of Germany 1780–1918: The Long Nineteenth Century
usage: 1780–1918; 1848 revolution and Frankfurt National Assembly; industrialisation; 1871 Empire; social, cultural and everyday history.
notes: Standard synthesis; first edition 1997; 2nd edition 2002. Publisher page verified; no DOI.

title: Social Democracy and the Working Class in Nineteenth and Twentieth Century Germany
usage: ADAV (1863), SDAP (1869), Gotha (1875), Anti-Socialist Law (1878), Erfurt programme (1891); SPD and the German labour movement.
notes: Synthesis; Routledge reissue 2014; DOI points to the reissue.

title: The Weimar Republic: The Crisis of Classical Modernity
authors: Detlev J. K. Peukert; trans. Richard Deveson
usage: Weimar politics and society; women's suffrage and welfare; cultural modernity; economic and legitimacy crisis.
notes: Translation of Die Weimarer Republik (1987); Internet Archive lending copy; no DOI.

title: The Years of Extermination: Nazi Germany and the Jews, 1939–1945
usage: Shoah; persecution and extermination 1939–1945; Wannsee; bureaucratic and military implementation.
notes: Pulitzer Prize-winning synthesis; publisher page verified; no DOI.

title: Forced Laborers in the Third Reich: An Overview
usage: Scale and categories of forced labour in the Third Reich; recruitment, exploitation and mortality; distinction between forced and slave labour.
notes: Peer-reviewed overview by a leading specialist.

title: A History of Foreign Labor in Germany, 1880–1980: Seasonal Workers, Forced Laborers, Guest Workers
usage: Long-run history of foreign labour; Ruhrpolen; forced labour; Gastarbeiter recruitment (1955–1973) and Anwerbestopp.
notes: Library catalogue record verified (National Diet Library); no DOI.

title: The People's State: East German Society from Hitler to Honecker
usage: GDR society and everyday life; gender; consumer socialism; participatory dictatorship; 1953 and 1989.
notes: Publisher page verified; no DOI.

title: The Other Alliance: Student Protest in West Germany and the United States in the Global Sixties
usage: 1968; SDS and APO; Rudi Dutschke; transatlantic student networks and protest repertoires.
notes: Monograph; DOI is the Princeton University Press e-book.

title: The Rush to German Unity
usage: 1989–1990; peaceful revolution; Leipzig and Berlin; accession of the GDR Länder; unification.
notes: Monograph; DOI is Oxford Scholarship Online.

title: German Colonialism: A Short History
usage: German colonial empire 1884–1918; war against the Herero and Nama; colonial violence and memory.
notes: Synthesis; DOI is the Cambridge University Press e-book.

title: The Greenest Nation? A New History of German Environmentalism
usage: German environmentalism; anti-nuclear movement; environmental policy; the 2011 nuclear phase-out in longer perspective.
notes: Synthesis; DOI is the MIT Press e-book; coverage ends in 2014.

title: The Dark Side of Nation-States: Ethnic Cleansing in Modern Europe
usage: Expulsion of Germans from East-Central Europe after 1945; ethnic cleansing and population transfer.
notes: Comparative synthesis; DOI is the JSTOR/Berghahn e-book.

title: Schlaglicht 1517: der sogenannte Thesenanschlag
usage: Historicity of the 95 theses posting; 31 October 1517 as a symbol; Luther's letters to the bishops.
notes: Scholarly article on bpb.de; bpb is a federal civic-education agency. Page verified.

title: Louise Otto-Peters
usage: Louise Otto-Peters; Allgemeiner Deutscher Frauenverein (1865); women's work, education and suffrage.
notes: bpb portrait; same institution as SRC-016 but a different page and author. Page verified.

title: Genocide of European Roma (Gypsies), 1939–1945
usage: Porajmos; persecution of Sinti and Roma; estimates of 250,000–500,000 victims; 2 August 1944 at Auschwitz-Birkenau.
notes: Institutional encyclopedia; estimates are explicitly uncertain. Page undated; accessed 2026-11-13.

title: Sorben in Sachsen
usage: Sorbs as a recognised national minority; about 60,000 in Germany; Bautzen/Budyšin as cultural centre; Domowina; bilingual rights.
notes: Official state portal; reliable for legal and institutional facts, not an independent historical synthesis. Page undated.

title: Außenminister Maas zum Abschluss der Verhandlungen mit Namibia
usage: 2021 German recognition of the Herero and Nama genocide; apology; 1.1 billion euro programme.
notes: Official press release: primary source for the 2021 declaration, not for the history of the genocide. Page verified.
